description: Find online stores that sell a product on a given platform (shopify, woocommerce, bigcommerce, or any), with each store confirmed on its own homepage. Give keywords and a platform. One row per store: domain, store_name, platform with platform_confidence and platform_evidence, myshopify_domain, payment_methods, subscription_apps, currencies, product_count (Shopify products feed), Tranco rank band and trend (a rank, not traffic), contact_emails, phone, and Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok links from the homepage, plus the search that found it. Sites that do not show the platform are skipped and not charged. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per confirmed store and per Google result page read.

country.description: Two letter country code for the Google market searched. Default US.

exclude_domains.description: Domains to skip, for example stores already in your CRM.

include_product_count.description: Read the Shopify public products feed for a product count. Default true.

include_traffic_rank.description: Add the Tranco top sites rank (not a visit count). Default true.

include_unconfirmed.description: Also return, free, sites whose homepage did not show the platform. Default false.

keywords.description: What the stores sell, for example coffee beans. Up to 50.

location_term.description: Optional word added to every search, such as Texas or Australia.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before any charge that would take it over this amount.

max_search_pages.description: Cap on Google result pages read; each is one search-page event. Empty or 0: set from max_stores.

max_stores.description: Stop after this many confirmed stores, up to 500. Each is one store-found event. Default 25.

platform.description: Store platform to find. any returns stores on any platform the homepage reveals. Default shopify.

name: discover_ecommerce_stores
title: Discover ecommerce stores
